seo.title: Awalim Group — we build the systems that run companies
seo.description: Awalim Group: a digital engineering house, from Palestine to the world. IFRS accounting systems, agentic AI, Flutter apps and web platforms. Founded 2021.

hero.eyebrow: From Palestine to the world · Founded 2021
hero.lede: Awalim Group is a digital engineering house building enterprise products that hold under real pressure: double-entry accounting on IFRS, AI agents that execute rather than chat, Flutter apps with native performance, and web platforms measured in milliseconds.

story.big: From a room in Gaza to systems running in ten countries
story.p: Awalim started in 2021 on a single conviction: the Arab engineer can build systems measured by the global standard. These are the milestones.

manifesto.h: The difference between a website and a system is the difference between a pitch and a product.
manifesto.p1: Most of what is sold in this region as a «platform» is a pretty interface over a spreadsheet. We build the layer nobody sees: balanced journal entries, multi-tenant data isolation, reversible migrations, tests that stop regressions, and an audit log that cannot be erased.
manifesto.p2: The beautiful interface comes after that — and it comes because the structure underneath has earned it.

why.h: Every reason here is one you can check
why.lede: We will not ask you to take our word. Under each reason is a link to where you verify it — on this site, now.

reasons.t: The code is yours from day one
reasons.d: In your repository, not ours, with the documentation, deploy accounts and database. If we stop tomorrow the system runs without us — and we never tie it to a maintenance contract.

reasons.t: Every number on this site is signed
reasons.d: The figures you read here are signed with an Ed25519 key, and verification runs in your browser, not on our server. An unsigned number is a claim, not a measurement.

reasons.t: The security page attacks itself in front of you
reasons.d: Five real attacks run in your browser and show you the browser refusing them one by one. If our policy ever weakens, that page is the first to tell you.

reasons.t: We measure ourselves the way we measure others
reasons.d: One browser, one session, one viewport, interleaved so a slow minute cannot favour anyone. And where we lose, it shows that we lost.

cmp.note: Median of {repeats} runs — one browser, one viewport, one session, loaded interleaved so a slow minute cannot favour one site over another. Measured {measured}.
cmp.caveat: It measures weight and speed only
cmp.caveatRest: it says nothing about which page is doing the harder job: a product homepage carries video and a store; this one carries an argument.

seo.title: Services — four disciplines we work in deeply | Awalim Group
seo.description: Enterprise systems, agentic AI, mobile engineering, and brand & interface — with a four-stage process and no surprises.

services.lede: We don't offer an endless service list. Four disciplines where we have real depth — and for everything else we point you to someone better than us.

items.h: Systems that handle money cannot afford «roughly right»
items.d: We build them to the standard of people who handle money: balanced entries, precise permissions, an audit log that cannot be erased, and migrations that can be reviewed and reverted.
includes: Finance and accounting: general ledger, receivables, inventory, fixed assets, and reports to international standards
HR and payroll: attendance, leave, payroll runs, and end-of-service provisions per country formula
Operations dashboards: live indicators, alerts, and view permissions per role
Integrations: banks, payment gateways, e-invoicing, and your existing systems over documented APIs
deliverables: An approved data model and API contracts
A system running on a live environment in weekly increments
Automated tests for the critical paths
Documentation, deployment accounts and database — all yours
items.for: Companies handling money or operations at a size that cannot absorb a mistake, and firms serving several entities.

items.h: The difference between a chatbot and an agent is responsibility
items.d: The first suggests text; the second changes state inside your system. We build the second — with explicit limits, a full log, and a human in the approval loop on every decision with a financial or legal effect.
includes: Document extraction: invoices, receipts and contracts from an image into structured fields
Knowledge systems that answer from your documents, with a citation on every answer
Workflow automation across your systems, stopping at the human decision points
Evaluation and governance: accuracy measured before launch, and a log for every decision
deliverables: A written task definition and permission boundary
An evaluation set and its results before deployment
An agent running inside your system with a decision log
The ability to swap the model without a rebuild
items.for: Teams repeating definable manual work: data entry, classification, answering questions from documents.

items.h: One codebase, and two experiences that both feel native
items.d: Flutter with clean state management that survives the product's growth — not quick fixes that collapse at the tenth feature.
includes: Figma to implementation, pixel-accurate, with full right-to-left support
Offline work: local storage and sync when the network returns
Store releases: accounts, review, versions and post-launch support
Measured performance: a frame and bundle budget watched on every release
deliverables: An iOS and Android app from one codebase
A component library that matches the design file
A release pipeline and automated tests
items.for: Products that need an app used daily in environments where the network really does drop.

items.h: An identity that never reaches the code is not an identity
items.d: We hand over a living system: design tokens, built components, and a usage guide that a developer and a designer both understand.
includes: Visual identity: mark, colour and type in a system that works on screen and in print
Design system: tokens and components in code, not slides
Arabic typography: spacing, joining and diacritics tuned properly
AA accessibility: contrast, keyboard navigation and screen-reader support
deliverables: Figma files with components and variables
A usage guide for screen and print
items.for: New brands, and digital products whose development team needs a system it can consume directly.

pricing.h: A written scope, then a price — not the other way round

models.d: An approved scope document with a stated price and schedule. Fits clearly defined projects.
A team working in weekly increments on a live environment, with a report and an invoice each week. Fits products that evolve.
An optional contract after handover for defects and updates. Your system's survival never depends on it.

seo.description: A real project, code review and tests — not a video series. Four engineering tracks, each ending in a published product.

academy.lede: Engineering tracks taught the way we actually work — a real project, code review and tests — not a video series.

tracks.d: From data modelling to migrations, indexes and transactions. You leave able to design a database that survives growth, not just to run a query.
Building agents that carry out real tasks: task definition, permission boundaries, knowledge systems, and accuracy evaluation before release.
tracks.project: A document-extraction agent with a human in the loop

tracks.d: From Figma to the app store: clean state management, offline work, full Arabic support, and measured performance.
tracks.project: An offline-capable app published to both stores

tracks.d: Design tokens, Arabic typography, contrast and accessibility — and how an identity reaches the code instead of staying in a slide deck.
tracks.project: An Arabic design system exported to code

philosophy.p: We start from a problem, not a topic. You write the code, we review it with you line by line, then you fix it and resubmit — exactly as it goes in a real team.

pillars.d: You build a single product across the whole track instead of scattered exercises.
Written notes on your own code, not a model answer.
You learn to write the test before you learn to write the feature.
You leave with a published project for your portfolio.

why.h: Training is not a revenue line
why.p1: It is how we build the team we later hire, and how we keep our engineering standards alive. When you explain an architectural decision to a hundred engineers, you find out quickly whether the decision was weak.
why.p2: A large part of the Awalim team today came out of the Academy.

seo.title: The Group — from a room in Gaza to systems running in ten countries | Awalim Group
seo.description: The story of Awalim Group: founded 2021 in Palestine. The timeline, the values, and a note from founder Ahmed Ashraf.

group.lede: Awalim Group is a digital engineering house founded in 2021 in Palestine. We build enterprise products to a global standard — and we measure ourselves by that standard and no other.

timeline.t: First line of code, from Gaza
timeline.d: A mobile phone and a slow connection. Starting from zero, and building the first iOS and Android apps to strict performance standards.
Fifty dollars that were less a fee than a proof that skill outruns geography.
Turning solo work into an engineering house with institutional standards: documentation, code review, and contractual responsibility.
The move from apps to systems: databases, permissions, and audit logs.
Engineering tracks begin — and a large part of today's team came from them.
The first agentic AI systems running inside real products at real clients.
Expanding from local clients to a regional and international network.
Our most mature product ships: an enterprise accounting system, Arabic from the root, on IFRS.

values.d: We publish no number we cannot prove, and no compliance badge we have not earned. If a feature is still in development, we write that.
Code, data and deployment accounts are handed over in full. We keep no key that makes staying with us compulsory.
We design right-to-left from the start: the typography, the numerals, the dates, and the whole visual flow.

values.t: Accessibility is a condition, not a feature
values.d: Everything we build is tested with a keyboard and a screen reader. Someone who cannot use the product was not built for.

founder.lede: He started in 2018 from Gaza with a mobile phone. He learned to program under siege, then turned individual skill into an engineering company in 2021.
full: I started in 2018 from Gaza with a mobile phone and a slow connection. The goal was never just to have work; it was to prove that an Arab engineer can build systems measured by the global standard — not by a lenient local one.

The first fifty dollars were less a fee than a proof that skill outruns geography. And when the solo work became an engineering house in 2021, the only condition was that the standards stay the same: documentation, code review, and contractual responsibility.

Today an engineering team serves clients in more than ten countries, and much of it came from the Academy we built to keep our standards alive. That is still the measure we hold everything we ship against.
